answer: A payout is split so that 46% arrives at settlement and the rest over 18 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The pigment schedule is applied in knoll and dawn makes public each instalment. A hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3999 identities would post 2173 proofs and burn roughly 72 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
